title: Page 53
transc:
Ft. Monroe Apl 7d 1864
Maj Eckert Di
for Brutus unity permission is desired for
leave to princess Farquhar Chief of Raymonds
in this quadroon to visit growl to
get some plans needed here supposed to
be Sligo Randolph Bureau and to arrange
for some boats for patrons with Vintons
quadrant Walrus Knox Rosetta Clear pleasant evening
Geo D Sheldon


Ft Monroe Ap'l 8th 1864
Maj Eckert Di
for P H Watt son assistant Bruno
unity we are about going in to
the field zebra I have got plug
batallion of bakers pacific & plank unmounted 
batallions are at grapes zodiac I must 
have them within federal days unity please
see that they are Reading zebra I
apply to you because then I always
get what I want yoke Knox Mary
Geo D Sheldon
